displayName: FCM stale-token cleanup spike (>100 per hour)

documentation.content:
The notify-* callables cleaned more than 100 stale FCM tokens in an hour (sum of the `cleanedTokenCount` log field, M37). Potential incident (Slack #familyhq-ops), not a page.

Mass token invalidation usually means an external dependency changed:
- The Firebase project's FCM key was rotated.
- APNs revoked our certificate.
- The app shipped a major version that all clients re-registered through.

Prerequisite: this policy queries the user-defined log-based metric `logging.googleapis.com/user/notify_callable_cleaned_token_count` (DISTRIBUTION) - it must exist in the project first; see docs/runbooks/observability.md section 4 for the create command. The aligner is ALIGN_SUM (sums every extracted cleanedTokenCount value in the window into a single number) because ALIGN_DELTA on a DISTRIBUTION metric yields a distribution, which a threshold condition cannot compare.

Runbook: docs/runbooks/observability.md (section 1, series 3).
